acceptance_signals: A real Codex CLI run using a one-off configuration override discovers exactly the canonical eight AgentGov MCP tool names.
The project .codex/config.toml content digest is identical before and after the replay.
The replay does not invoke agentgov_task_completion_record or agentgov_drift_review_record.
The evidence document clearly distinguishes tool discovery from successful stateful invocation.
Focused documentation tests and the full baseline test suite pass without weakening existing tests.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-400e337a2caf45d7b43002e414d9a4f5 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Use a one-off Codex CLI configuration override to collect bounded evidence that a real Codex consumer discovers exactly the canonical eight AgentGov MCP tools, without changing project MCP configuration or invoking completion and drift-review workflows.

items: Windows command-line TOML quoting may prevent the one-off override from parsing; if so, stop without editing project configuration.
A consumer-visible tool list proves discovery only and must not be reported as completion or drift-review execution evidence.
Reviewed assumption: The installed Codex CLI supports one-off -c configuration overrides with higher precedence than project configuration.
Reviewed assumption: The local AgentGov MCP server continues to advertise the canonical eight-tool contract.
Reviewed unknown: The exact real Codex discovery output shape may differ by installed CLI version, but any adaptation must remain read-only and within the admitted evidence scope.

title: Real Codex eight-tool discovery replay
